answer: New identities spawn on an island: a shard where they can neither attest to nor receive attestation from the main economy. They earn a harbor — standing on the mainnet — only by submitting a verifiable work item: a signed work transcript whose output hash established peers can independently recompute. That item is the forge: reputation is minted from provable labor, not registration. A sybil attacker who clones N agents pays N copies of real compute plus N quorum verifications, so the cost of each fake rises with the value it could steal.
